title: Revenue Operations Manager
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. The Role We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations. This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one. What You'll Do First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards. First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership. First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence. What Will You Be Doing? Revenue Analytics & Insights Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order. Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan. Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on. Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it. Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep. Business Partnership to Revenue leadership Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization. Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations. Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa. Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround. Forecasting Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking. Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion. Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement. What Will You Need to Succeed? 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level. Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization. Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data. A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call. A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work. Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation. Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role. Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus. What we Offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Architect
description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE: Technical Architect</strong></p> <p>We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who would rather find the problem on paper than on the data hall floor. It suits someone who will push back on an inherited design or a customer requirement that won’t perform, and who carries authority through owning the design rather than managing people.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated</li> <li>Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you</li> <li>Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre</li> <li>Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes</li> <li>Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution</li> <li>Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baseline rather than a blank page</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><em>Essential:</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ve designed and delivered large-scale GPU or HPC clusters into live data centres, and you were on site for the build</li> <li>Deep, practical knowledge of NVIDIA platforms (GB200/GB300 rack-scale and HGX H200/B200) and what each one demands of a facility</li> <li>Cluster-scale InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric design: topology, rail optimisation, oversubscription, and cable and optic selection</li> <li>Physical infrastructure design across power and redundancy, direct liquid cooling and CDUs, containment and achievable cable lengths</li> <li>You know part numbers, what’s optional and what isn’t, and you can hold an OEM to account when their commitments slip</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Factory integration and FAT experience, including holding a dispatch gate</li> <li>Storage design for AI workloads (WEKA, VAST, DDN, Ceph or similar)</li> <li>Deployments across multiple geographies and data centre operators, including sites requiring fit-out</li> <li>Neocloud or hyperscale experience on compressed schedules</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> <br><strong><span data-contrast="none">We value </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</span><strong><span data-contrast="none"> </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h3><strong> </strong></h3> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.</li> <li>Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.</li> <li>Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.</li> <li>Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.</li> <li>Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.</li> <li>Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.</li> <li>Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.</li> <li>Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku?</strong> </h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.</li> <li>2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.</li> <li>Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.</li> <li>Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.</li> <li>Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> <li>Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. title: Global Account Executive at United Media
description: <p><em>Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?</em></p> <p><em>Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?</em></p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>You’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.</p> <p>This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.</p> <h3>What we’re looking for</h3> <p>We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.</p> <p>You should have:</p> <ul> <li> <p>At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing client relationships, retaining customers and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Confidence engaging, pitching and negotiating with senior decision-makers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify new revenue opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ambition, resilience and ownership – you take responsibility for your portfolio, performance and results.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>This role might not be the right fit if...</h3> <ul> <li> <p>You prefer a role focused purely on relationship management, without responsibility for sales and revenue.</p> </li> <li> <p>You don't enjoy negotiating, closing deals and working towards commercial targets.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're not comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're looking for a hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Manage and retain sponsors:</strong> Build strong, long-term relationships with an existing portfolio of sponsors, driving renewals and repeat business.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Grow existing accounts:</strong> Identify opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and increase sponsorship revenue within your portfolio.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive new business:</strong> Identify, pitch and close new sponsorship opportunities to expand our client base.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Own your revenue targets:</strong> Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Deliver exceptional partnerships:</strong> Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What we offer</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Competitive salary and market-leading OTE.</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.</p> </li> <li> <p>The opportunity to work closely with our senior leadership team.</p> </li> <li> <p>International travel to our conferences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Training, coaching and ongoing development.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong opportunities for internal progression as we continue to grow.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About us</h3> <p>United Media is building a global B2B media and conferences group, bringing together executives, investors, founders and industry leaders through conferences, communities and media brands. Our portfolio spans industries including private equity, insurance, finance, HR and retail, creating opportunities for professionals to connect, learn and grow.</p> <p><strong>Start date:</strong> As soon as possible.</p> <p>Monday–Friday, we work from our <strong>WeWork office in Victoria, London</strong>. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.</p> <p>You must have the <strong>right to work in the UK</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Expert Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the<a href="https://www.wiz.io/blog/100m-arr-in-18-months-wiz-becomes-the-fastest-growing-software-company-ever"> fastest-growing startups ever,</a> we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven<a href="https://www.g2.com/products/wiz-wiz/reviews"> track record of success</a> and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now<a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/identity-security/google-completes-acquisition-of-wiz"> powered by Google</a>, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.</p> <p>Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!</p></div><h4><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor of Science in Computer Science/Software Engineering or related field.</li> <li>6 + years of experience with Backend Engineering in a high-level programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Golang).</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with microservices based architecture.</li> <li>Experience with databases and message queue technologies.</li> <li>Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).</li> <li>Familiarity or experience with Golang, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Neptune, Docker, and Kubernetes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Job<br><br></strong>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Backend Engineer</strong> to join our expanding R&D team and help drive the growth of Wiz. In this role, you'll be responsible for developing and maintaining large-scale distributed components that power Wiz. title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software. About the Role As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices Grow the team through hiring Our humble expectations You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure What we offer A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! The compensation will be a combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners. Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion. Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change. Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design. Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest. Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights. What you bring: Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates. Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits. Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks. Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines. It’s great if you have: Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline. How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it. This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you. What You'll Work On The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona. The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this. The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one. The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work. Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one. You'll Probably Have Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready. Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy. Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them. Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them. Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes. Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires. Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration. Experience & Skills: Essential: Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure. Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain. Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware. Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab. Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level. Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in. Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption. Desirable: SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches. Comfortable working in Linux operating systems. Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link. C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation. Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection. Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug. Educational Background: Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design. Key Attributes & Behaviours: Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench. Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which. Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room. Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA. Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through. Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move. Success Indicators: Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench. Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly. Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work. Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from: Pension: 5% company contribution. Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build. Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays. Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker). Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows. Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented) Why Join Us This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers. Location & Work Environment Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, please let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p>We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.</p> <p>If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set product direction and priorities</strong>, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Define problems and experiences before solutions</strong>, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.</li> <li><strong>Lead product initiatives end-to-end</strong>, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.</li> <li><strong>Make sound product decisions and trade-offs</strong>, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.</li> <li><strong>Develop product opportunities with external partners</strong>, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate successful launches and adoption</strong>, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with clarity throughout</strong>, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a strong track record of <strong>owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end</strong>, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>You’re a <strong>strong problem solver</strong> who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.</li> <li>You operate with <strong>independence and initiative</strong>: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.</li> <li>You have <strong>strong business and commercial awareness</strong> and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.</li> <li>You’re <strong>technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering</strong>, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.</li> <li>You’re an <strong>exceptional communicator</strong>, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.</li> <li>You’re comfortable <strong>operating externally as well as internally</strong>, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.</li> <li>You have a strong sense of <strong>product and user experience</strong>, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>The benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. </p> <p><br>Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of title: Head of Product Design
description: <div class="description content"> <p><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/">Thoughtworks</a> is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.<br><br>Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.</p> <p>Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li> <h3>Website product strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com</li> <li>Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages</li> <li>Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Customer journeys and experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community</li> <li>Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site</li> <li>Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities</li> <li>Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Narrative, copy and content quality</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture</li> <li>Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences</li> <li>Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need</li> <li>Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience</li> <li>Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Experiences for people and agents</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants</li> <li>Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process</li> <li>Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information</li> <li>Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Publishing model for the AI era</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement</li> <li>Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation</li> <li>Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance</li> <li>Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks</li> <li>Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Design quality and experimentation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system</li> <li>Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time</li> <li>Sign off on experience quality before major launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team and agency leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability</li> <li>Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work</li> <li>Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design</li> <li>A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences</li> <li>Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like</li> <li>Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy</li> <li>Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders</li> <li>Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes</li> <li>Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks</li> <li>Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information</li> <li>Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured</li> <li>The ability to operate in ambiguity, make difficult prioritization decisions and move from strategy to delivery</li> <li>Evidence of leading and coaching people or multidisciplinary teams.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>You have a natural ability to establish and nurture relationships with senior leaders across the organization</li> <li>You have excellent context-switching capabilities</li> <li>You thrive in situations where you are given little to no direction and have the ability to lead, organize and deliver commitments on time and within budget</li> <li>You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You don’t shy away from risks, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them</li> <li>You’re empathetic and use this ability to build solid working relationships and resolve issues quickly and thoughtfully</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. </p> <p>As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.</p> <p>You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.</p> <p>Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.</p> <p>You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.</p> <p>We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.</p> <p>You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.</p> <p>One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.</li> <li>Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.</li> <li>Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.</li> <li>Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li>Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li>Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li>Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li>Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li>Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li>Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover</li> <li>Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>If you want to explore how complex AI systems really behave, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Systems Engineering team.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, System Software
description: <h3>About the job</h3> <p>Lead the system software organisation that turns complex hardware platforms into reliable Graphcore systems. As Director of System Software, you will report to the VP of Software and turn software strategy into clear priorities, plans and outcomes. You will lead the teams delivering firmware, drivers, OpenBMC and system software QA. Your work will shape platform bring-up, production release and long-term support across Graphcore systems. You will align technical decisions with business priorities, delivery milestones and product readiness. You will build a strong engineering organisation, developing managers, technical leaders and engineers. You will own execution, quality and cross-functional delivery across hardware, silicon, software and product teams.</p> <p>This is a role for a leader who can think big, act fast and take responsibility for complex system outcomes.</p> <h3>The team and culture</h3> <p>System Software works close to the hardware, where small decisions can shape product reliability at scale.
