title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.</strong></p> <p>Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.</p> <p>With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.</p> <p><strong>The job</strong></p></div><h1><strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong></h1> <p>More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job.</p> <p>Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the foundations:</strong> Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense.</li> <li><strong>Turn expertise into self-service:</strong> Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Kubernetes at scale:</strong> Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure:</strong> Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time.</li> <li><strong>Golden paths:</strong> Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security.</li> <li><strong>Reliability:</strong> Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation.</li> <li><strong>Privacy at scale:</strong> Support the infrastructure behind privacy features such as our TIME-recognised "Anonymous Mode", and keep us SOC2, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified while handling some of the most sensitive data there is.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Make sure metrics, logs and traces tell us something is wrong before our users do.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Many years in infrastructure, platform, SRE or DevOps roles running high-traffic, distributed systems in production. You have operated at Principal or Staff scope, setting direction across teams as well as delivering.</li> <li><strong>Kubernetes depth:</strong> You have run Kubernetes in production for real workloads, ideally EKS. You can explain what happens between kubectl apply and a pod serving traffic, and you have debugged it when it didn't.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure awareness:</strong> You understand how PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka behave under load and when they fail: connection limits, replication lag, hot partitions, consumer lag, retention. You don't need to have been a DBA, but you know what good looks like and when to ask for help.</li> <li><strong>AWS and infrastructure as code:</strong> Strong AWS knowledge and fluent Terraform. Coding experience in Go or Python is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> A doc-first habit, and the ability to bring distributed product teams with you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI first: you will have seen the impact AI automation is having on development teams and the software delivery lifecycle, and have strong ideas on how infrastructure should support it.</strong></p> <h2><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hardening infrastructure for high-compliance or security-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI).</li> <li>Running managed data services in AWS (RDS, Aurora, MSK, DynamoDB) at scale, including migrations and major version upgrades.</li> <li>Scaling consumer platforms with millions of concurrent users.</li> <li>Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, CKA or CKS.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Flo?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>High impact:</strong> Flo is used by 1 in 4 women aged 18–44 in the US, and has raised $200M to build what comes next.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> We hire experts and trust them to deliver.</li> <li><strong>Modern stack at scale:</strong> EKS, Terraform, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Sentry, serving more than 80 million people a month.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£130,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£150,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.</p> <p>You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it. </p> <p><strong>What you'll get</strong></p> <p>We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual reviews</li> <li>Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme</li> <li>Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave</li> <li>Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents</li> <li>Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support</li> <li>In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office</li> <li>5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary</li> <li>Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks</li> </ul> <p><strong>Diversity, equity and inclusion</strong></p> <p>Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our <a href="https://flo.health/privacy-policy-for-job-applicants">privacy notice for job applicants</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h4><strong>UX Researcher </strong></h4> <ul> <li>Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)</li> <li>Team: UX</li> <li>Salary: £58,000 - £70,000</li> <li>Contract: Permanent</li> <li>Reporting To: UX Lead</li> </ul> <p>Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring <br></strong><br>Ideally you’ll have/be</p> <ul> <li>A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us</li> <li>Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how</li> <li>Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve</li> <li>Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods</li> <li>Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy</li> <li>Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will set you apart</strong> </p> <ul> <li>You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight</li> <li>You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)</li> <li>You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where you'll work<br></strong>We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.</p> <h4><strong>Our Values<br></strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Play to win:</strong> Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.</li> <li><strong>Solve the real problem:</strong> Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Build trust every day:</strong> Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.</li> <li><strong>Own the outcome:</strong> Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.</li> <li><strong>Go further together: </strong>Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Our Perks</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Time off and family:</strong> 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period</li> <li><strong>Health and security:</strong> Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests</li> <li><strong>Pay and flexibility:</strong> Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work</li> <li><strong>Growth and setup:</strong> Personal learning budget, home office budget</li> <li><strong>Climate:</strong> Furthr, our climate action app</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Come as you are</strong></h4> <p>We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.</p> <p>Find out more on our<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/careers/"> careers page</a> and<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/"> LinkedIn</a>. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice/"> here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. title: Principal Technical Consultant
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services. You will: Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more. Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs. Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations. Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients. Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements. Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise. Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies. Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles). Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment. Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources. Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early. Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations. Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed. Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning. Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery. Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations. You have: 5+ years of experience working in a consulting capacity with a minimum of 2 years working directly in the Identity and Access Management space within a large organization or enterprise Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience A capability-maturity approach to IAM deployments Comfortable with subjects such as TCP/IP networking, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Data Stores Experience with Java/JavaScript/Groovy, HTML/CSS to support web application development Experience in effort estimates and sizing of projects Self-motivated, willing to take initiative, organized, able to work unaccompanied, and manage communications appropriately Bachelor of Science in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Information Systems) or equivalent work-related level of experience Availability to travel up to 50% of the time Outstanding cross-functional cooperation skills in particular with our Go-To-Market units. Excellent communication, both verbal and written Practical experience integrating IAM platforms with enterprise directories, applications, APIs, and identity systems, including federation, authentication, and user lifecycle or provisioning flows. Experience with identity standards and protocols such as SCIM, HTTP/REST APIs, and common directory and federation patterns, in addition to OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, FIDO and LDAP. Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations. Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues. Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations. Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes. Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement. You have an advantage if: Computer and Software Security certifications ForgeRock or Ping training badges/certifications Skills with DevOps best practices, including deployment automation tools, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes Experience with Ping Identity products and architectures, such as PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, PingOne, or PingID. Experience with identity governance, privileged access, customer identity, or workforce identity use cases beyond a single IAM product or deployment pattern. Familiarity with observability and operational tooling, such as centralised logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing. Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments. Experience migrating identity services, applications, or user populations from legacy platforms to modern IAM architectures. Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Product Manager, Pricing
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience. This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. About the Team Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users. The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics. Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth? What You'll Do Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products. Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability. Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X. Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities. Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy. Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics. Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash. What We're Looking For You might be a great fit if you: Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products. Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions. Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems. Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps. Can operate as a "conductor" — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo and Wolt, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. ➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog . We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here . Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We are rebuilding that from the ground up. You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. title: Software Engineer - Core Video & Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><p>We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our Core Data team in London.</p> <p>This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale. From identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the centre of Hudl’s platform.</p> <p>You’ll work on the Global Sports Library (GSL), the backbone that connects identities, metadata and game context across Hudl products. That means designing APIs, distributed services and large-scale data pipelines that help ensure every product at Hudl is operating from the same understanding of the game.</p> <p>The work is backend-heavy and deeply technical: data modeling, entity resolution, ingestion pipelines, consistency challenges, scalability and platform design. The systems you build won’t just support one product or one sport, they’ll become shared capabilities used across the company.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Collaborate across disciplines.</strong> You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, quality analysts, product managers and designers to build foundational data tools for the best of the best in sports.</li> <li><strong>Deliver backend-heavy features.</strong> Your team has the autonomy to build and maintain the GSL, ensuring market teams have access to reliable, comprehensive data infrastructure. We iterate rapidly and deploy changes to our products hundreds of times a day.</li> <li><strong>Propose new solutions.</strong> You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges within the Core Data domain and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.</li> <li><strong>Thrive on the front lines.</strong> You’ll build pipelines and libraries that power every feature delivered to coaches and athletes, getting firsthand experience with how our data impacts the game.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong technical proficiency.</strong> You have at least three years of experience in engineering, specifically within backend-heavy or data-heavy environments.</li> <li><strong>Cloud experience.</strong> You’ve spent time working with cloud-based systems and services and are a strong advocate for TDD and CI/CD.</li> <li><strong>Experience navigating uncertainty.</strong> You’re comfortable taking on ambiguous work with many possible implementation options and identifying the one that pragmatically balances quality and immediate customer value.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative, team-first mindset.</strong> You understand that building great software is a team effort and you’re always willing to pitch in or provide quality feedback in code reviews.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity.</strong> You enjoy picking up new technologies and domains on the job. The idea of working across foundational layers of our stack and multiple products energizes you.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Tech stack knowledge.</strong> Professional background in C#, GraphQL, Elastic, MongoDB and AWS is ideal.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure background.</strong> Experience working in environments with significant data scale and complex infrastructure needs.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with hybrid teams.</strong> You’ve worked with hybrid or remote teams before and can adapt quickly to our international working environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role </h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong>. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong>. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth. </strong>We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong>. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£51,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£86,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team
description: Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team. You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers. The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing. There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month. The role As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them. You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers. The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need. Live project examples: Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer. No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay. Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments. Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists. Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems. The requirements Essential: Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind. Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React. Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them. Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why. AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code. Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next. Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it. Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve. WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems. Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better. Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself. You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both. You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better. Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference. We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real. Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most. The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers. Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without. WHY CARWOW? Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 28 days annual leave 1 day for your wedding 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual. For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Product Strategy & Execution: Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity Partner Engagement & Insight: Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions Cross-functional Leadership: Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you NICE TO HAVE Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context Background in scale-up or high-growth environments Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min) Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min) Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task) Step 4: Values Interview (45 min) WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. title: VP of Marketing
description: Get to know us Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours. Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR) : Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions. Ideals Board : Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making. The role Ideals is uniquely positioned to redefine the VDR industry. Now we aim to own the upmarket M&A segment and establish Ideals as the Tier 1 brand in that space - translating market leadership into stronger brand equity, pipeline, and revenue. We're looking for a VP of Marketing to make this happen. You'll lead a high-performing global team and shape the marketing function end-to-end: positioning and category authority, a scalable demand engine, and the operating system behind it. This is a builder's role for a strategic, data-driven leader who wants their work to show up in commercial results, not just in brand tracking. This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the UK , Ireland, Switzerland, or the Netherlands. What you will do Define how Ideals wins You'll own positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and GTM plans across every product, segment, and region – the strategic foundation everything else in marketing builds on. Build category authority From industry events, reports, and benchmarks to media relations, executive visibility, and speaking programmes - you'll make Ideals the name the upmarket M&A segment thinks of first, and keep every external touchpoint aligned with our brand positioning. Turn attention into pipeline You'll drive demand generation across paid and organic channels, ABM, content, and nurture, then guide the team capturing it through search, review platforms, intent data, and conversion optimisation. As the Key Accounts Sales team scales, you'll direct regional programmes into each market's sales plan and own the result end to end against pipeline and revenue targets. Run marketing as a system You'll own the martech and analytics stack, attribution, KPI framework, and ROI reporting – plus the marketing budget, agencies, and strategic vendors – so every decision is data-driven, and every dollar is accountable. Lead the people who make it happen You'll hire, develop, and lead a global team, and work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to drive cohesive business growth. What you bring 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong SaaS background 4+ years in a senior marketing leadership role within a fast-growing company, with responsibility for the broader marketing function Proven experience leading and scaling diverse high-performing marketing teams, including hiring, talent development, and performance management Brand marketing portfolio with proven activation expertise across diverse channels and markets Hands-on experience across content, design, and growth initiatives, with the ability to go deep when needed Track record scaling digital and field marketing programs that measurably grew pipeline and revenue Solid understanding of demand generation and ABM initiatives Successful track record of implementing marketing initiatives based on analytical and data-driven decisions Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a can-do attitude Fluency in English (C1+ level) Nice to have Experience in M&A, Investment Banking, or Financial Services, with a strong understanding of the dealmaking ecosystem What we offer We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential. description: We're always keen to hear from talented sales professionals. Our password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey solutions make it easy for everyone to extend robust security across their devices. Bitwarden is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, with a team located across the globe. What our Account Executives do Own a territory and an assigned quota, closing new business with a focus on organisations of 1,000+ employees Prospect effectively and manage lead flow to build a strong pipeline (typically 3–5x coverage) Manage and forecast the pipeline accurately in our CRM Build territory plans that deliver both short-term and long-term revenue Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners' customers Keep sales leadership informed on channel pipeline and forecast Who we'd love to hear from 4–8 years of SaaS sales experience in new business or business development. title: Enforcement Appeals Specialist
description: Introduction to Role & Team Bumble Inc. is looking for an Enforcement Appeals Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on candidate who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to support the evolution of our Trust Operations team. In this position, you will investigate and respond to members' appeals as a result of account restrictions and content moderation. You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material. Trust and safety are embedded in Bumble Inc.’s mission of creating a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Our wider Trust organization includes centralized and dedicated teams focused on: Creating products and systems that proactively detect and prevent harm and promote healthy, kind relationships. Developing policies that govern and adjudicate responsible, safe, inclusive, and respectful behaviour and content across all Bumble Inc. platforms. Supporting members who experience safety incidents in a trauma-informed, empathetic manner. This role will be based in London, UK reporting to the Enforcement Appeals Manager. Please note: This position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content. What You’ll Do Review and take action on members’ appeals for content removals, account bans, or other enforcement actions in a timely and accurate manner. Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents. Collaborate with internal teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, to escalate and resolve complex safety cases. Help enforce Bumble Inc.’s policies by reviewing and processing accounts and content flagged for safety violations. Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as needed. About You Have 2–4 years of experience in a Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, or content moderation role, preferably in a high-risk or safety-focused environment. Have demonstrated ability to work with sensitive content and provide support in cases involving child exploitation, sexual violence, and self-harm. Have experience handling high-touch safety escalations, particularly those involving vulnerable individuals. Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, empathetic, and professional responses. Have experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcers (BPOs) to ensure quality and consistency in safety-related workflows (preferred). Are able to work independently, prioritize urgent tasks, and make sound judgment calls under pressure. Have proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another second language (preferred). Are passionate about Bumble’s mission and values. Are empathetic, resilient, and comfortable working in emotionally challenging situations. Have a strong understanding of online safety issues and best practices in Trust & Safety. Are detail-oriented and able to balance efficiency with thoughtful decision-making. Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Benefits & Perks Annual personal learning & development budget Private Medical Insurance (PMI) Private Dental Insurance Babylon Health app Mental health support Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package Unlimited PTO Subsidised gym membership ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6% Premium App Access About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Inclusion at Bumble Inc. Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc). AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly. Fraudulent Candidate Detection Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy . We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. norms we're building from scratch — your ideas about how we do things will actually get heard and implemented Act as the connective tissue between our customers and Orbital’s Product, Engineering, and Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>
